label: PAR 30 amount
definition: Principal outstanding of loans 30+ days past due (cumulative, CGAP)

label: PAR 60 amount
definition: Principal outstanding of loans 60+ days past due

label: PAR 90 amount
definition: Principal outstanding of loans 90+ days past due

label: PAR 30 ratio
definition: PAR 30 amount / GLP; null when GLP is zero

label: NPA amount
definition: Principal outstanding of loans flagged non-performing by Fineract

label: Watch-list amount
definition: Principal outstanding of loans 1-29 days past due

label: Performing amount
definition: Principal outstanding of loans neither PAR 30 nor watch-list

label: Active borrowers
definition: Distinct borrowers with an active loan

label: Collection efficiency
definition: Collected / contractually due on the same date
grain: office x product x client x day
